label: Time & Energy Management
source: owner corpus content/rules.json (frozen); decisions index-joined to corpus rule order

added.text: Keep at least one hobby that exists only for enjoyment. Not every hour needs a return.
Schedule periods with no screens and no connectivity. The mind cannot restore itself in the same environment that depletes it.
added.source_figure: Henry David Thoreau, Ralph Waldo Emerson

added.text: Take vacations that fully disconnect you from work. Half-rest leaves you neither restored nor productive.
Keep one full day each week free of work. Unbroken rest is a discipline, not a reward.
Spend time outdoors without a destination or agenda. Nature restores attention and perspective that no indoor activity can replace.
